name: spin-ladder-synth
description: A two-spin NMR synthesizer with a ladder filter, an 8-bit mode, a psytrance/song engine, autopilot lessons, and a JSON song spec + CLI that AI agents can compose with.

scripts.all: npm run fixture && npm test && npm run songs && npm run build
scripts.songs: node cli/spin-ladder.js validate songs/simple-song.json && node cli/spin-ladder.js validate songs/level-1-loop.json && node cli/spin-ladder.js validate songs/live-set.json
